subject.title: feat: audit PR review convergence at exact head

question: Should this audit directly resolve required checks from the pull request target branch’s protection/ruleset policy, with UNKNOWN when that policy is unavailable?
rationale: The advertised READY/BLOCKED decision is only trustworthy if requiredness comes from an authoritative repository policy rather than a potentially incomplete injected check list.

options.title: Resolve target policy in the audit
options.body: Fetch and normalize the target branch’s applicable required-check policy, then return UNKNOWN whenever authoritative policy collection is incomplete.

options.title: Keep caller-supplied requiredness
options.body: Retain the provider contract but narrow the tool and documentation so it cannot claim an authoritative merge-readiness decision.

recommendation.title: Resolve target policy in the audit
recommendation.body: Fetch and normalize the target branch’s applicable required-check policy, then return UNKNOWN whenever authoritative policy collection is incomplete.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision concerns the existing ClawSweeper proof and merge-readiness policy integration.
